modmenu.descriptionTranslation.imperium_: European empire simulation expansion for MineColonies.
commands.imperium.no_colony: You must stand inside a MineColonies colony to use this command.
commands.imperium.no_permission: You need the MineColonies Manage Huts permission to change imperial finances or propose or resolve legislation.
commands.imperium.tax_rate_unchanged: The imperial tax rate is already %1$s%%.
commands.imperium.taxes_already_collecte: Taxes have already been collected for this in-game day.
commands.imperium.taxes_collected: Collected %1$s crowns; paid %2$s crowns in policy upkeep. Treasury balance: %3$s crowns.
commands.imperium.upkeep_unpaid: Treasury shortage: %1$s crowns of policy upkeep remain unpaid.
commands.imperium.parliament_status: %1$s — Active proposal: %2$s. Votes: %3$s yes, %4$s no; total votes %5$s.
commands.imperium.parliament_no_active_p: There is no active parliamentary proposal.
commands.imperium.parliament_proposal_re: A proposal is already active, or this law has already been enacted.
commands.imperium.parliament_proposal_op: Parliament has opened a proposal for %1$s. Members can vote using /imperium parliament vote yes|no.
commands.imperium.parliament_not_member: Only members of this MineColonies colony can vote in its parliament.
commands.imperium.parliament_vote_reject: No proposal is open, or you have already voted on this proposal.
commands.imperium.parliament_vote_yes: Your vote in favor has been recorded.
commands.imperium.parliament_vote_no: Your vote against has been recorded.
commands.imperium.parliament_too_early: A proposal can be resolved only after one full in-game day of debate.
commands.imperium.parliament_law_passed: %1$s passed with %2$s votes in favor and %3$s against. Its effect has been applied.
commands.imperium.parliament_law_failed: %1$s failed with %2$s votes in favor and %3$s against.
